t: Water-resistant, 20W rechargeable worklight. Provides a bright 1900lm output with a 6500K colour temperature. Offers 3 hours of run-time, but with a possible 6 hours in ‘Low Mode’. Adjustable head for precise light direction and can easily be mounted to a tripod for added versatility across a range of tasks. Features LED power charge indicator, carry handle, surface mounted diode (SMD) and 66 x LED lights. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use.
